A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 29-page versions of GLOV. Their main text, equations, Figures 1–8, Tables 1–6, Algorithm 1, and Appendices A–D support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification and VQA experiments, guidance ablations, and prompt-transfer evaluations in Section 4, with additional few-shot results in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains those original empirical results, including the 16-dataset evaluations in Tables 1–2 and appendix comparisons in Tables 5–6.

M1.justification: Section 3, Appendix A, and Algorithm 1 retain the same meta-prompt, fitness functions, sentence-embedding offset guidance, and iterative prompt-optimization procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 16 recognition datasets, four FOCI multiple-choice VQA subsets, and SST-5 sentiment-classification probe. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same comparators: CLIP prompt baselines, LLM-OPT, LLaVa-OV, Meta-Prompt, CoOp in Table 5, and ActADD in Figure 3a.

E3.justification: The test splits, one-shot prompt selection, top-three ensembling, model configurations, and optimization budgets in Section 4.1 are unchanged. The four-way VQA protocol and appendix five-shot settings also match.

E4.justification: The guidance and layer ablations in Figures 3–4, prompt-transfer evaluation in Table 4, shot-count analysis in Table 6, and optimization and prompt-evolution analyses in Figures 6–8 are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports independent repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or formal significance tests. The descriptions of accuracy trajectories and exponential moving averages in Figures 1 and 6 are identical.

E6.justification: All result entries, plotted trajectories, and qualitative prompt examples match. For example, GLOV's ImageNet accuracy remains 64.5% with CLIP in Table 1 and 51.7% with LLaVa-OV in Table 2.

T1.justification: Equations 1–6 retain identical classification and fitness definitions, embedding averaging, and guidance updates. No mathematical assumption, derivation, theorem, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about guided LLM prompt optimization improving both VLM families, with identical coverage and reported improvement claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning guidance effectiveness, middle-layer semantics, prompt transfer, and low-shot overfitting remain identical. Section 4.3 still leaves broader open-ended VQA exploration to future work.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, hardware disclosures, encoder-decoder fitness details, appendix prompt lists, and pseudocode are unchanged. The project-page and other access URLs also match.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the bibliography retain the same cited works and positioning relative to OPRO, ActADD, LLM-OPT, and Meta-Prompt. Citation-color changes do not alter research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 changes the first author's listed affiliation from TU Graz to MIT CSAIL, renumbers affiliations, and expands the work-location footnote to mention TU Graz. The research prose and section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 changes citations and internal cross-references from black to blue tones, including references within tables and captions. The eight figures and six tables retain their content, structure, and placement; other visual edits are confined to first-page administrative text.

improvement.justification: The affiliation and work-attribution updates and colored links are limited administrative and cosmetic edits. The scientific argument, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, and appendix analyses are unchanged, supporting no meaningful net difference in overall paper quality.
